game_title: Strip And Replace – Ice Cave Shelter Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Ice Cave Shelter, a shelter in an ice cave: the mountaineer must handle falling rocks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Ice Cave Shelter: a shelter in an ice cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Cave Shelter, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round, falling rocks strike the flag pole, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the flag pole from falling rocks in Ice Cave Shelter: keep the clean_text meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: clean_text drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 24-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against falling rocks in Ice Cave Shelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 24 seconds while clean_text > 0.
